rules: Citizens never read the simulation state directly.
Knowledge must have a source: observation, household, workplace, local notice or social transmission.
Rumor confidence depends on source trust, repetition and epistemic traits.
False or uncertain beliefs are allowed and persistent until corrected.
No citizen may know another country's existence, name, population, institutions or location at turn 0.
Mobile workers may know one or more settlements within their own country.
Official statements are not automatically believed.

the near-shore catch has shifted farther from the harbor than older crews remember
crowded dock water is contributing to recurring stomach illness

ARCA-PORT-02.claim: the outer current has become less predictable over the last few seasons
salt yields are lower when autumn storms arrive early

ARCA-RIDGE-01.claim: some upper slopes are becoming unstable after heavy cutting

goat grazing is moving higher each year

MIREA-RIVER-02.claim: wetland water levels are falling earlier in the warm season

MIREA-RIVER-03.claim: clearing upstream channels is reducing water in parts of the marsh

MIREA-MARKET-01.claim: traders with storage space are benefiting most from seasonal price swings

the main road receives less maintenance than lowland routes
young adults who leave rarely return permanently

VALD-BASIN-01.claim: official reserve targets are based on winters milder than the worst remembered seasons

VALD-BASIN-02.claim: production pressure is causing some mine supports to be replaced too late

VALD-UPPER-01.claim: central planners underestimate how much winter grazing the upland herds need
